description: Write a high-retention YouTube script — explainer, tutorial, video essay, review, or talking head — on the packaging then cold-open then value-stack then retention structure that holds watch time past the drop-off cliffs. Use when asked to write a YouTube script, script a long-form or explainer video, draft a video hook, outline a video essay, or turn a blog post or talk into a video.
